newsitem.title: JAPAN: JGBs end higher, short-term cash bonds bought.
newsitem.headline: JGBs end higher, short-term cash bonds bought.

text.p: Key December Japanese government bond futures ended higher on Thursday, pushed up by falls in short-term interest rates.
"Interest rate swap rates are down, and three-month certificates of deposits (CDs) were issued at their lowest rate this year," said a trader for a long-term credit bank's securities affiliate.

"Falls in long-term interest rates had been curtailed recently by the belief that short-term interest rates would not decline further, so when short-term rates fell today, it led to falls in long-term interest rates as well," he said.
